title: Internshala
description: India's go-to platform for internships, off-campus jobs and training — filter by role, stipend and work-from-home.

title: Naukri
description: One of India's largest job portals — set up a profile, upload your resume and let recruiters find you.

title: LinkedIn Jobs
description: Company pages, easy-apply listings and direct recruiter DMs — the most used channel for off-campus hiring.

title: Unstop
description: Hackathons, competitions, job fairs and campus drives from top companies — one stop for talent hunts.

title: Wellfound
description: Startup-focused jobs — apply directly to fast-growing companies, many open to freshers off campus.

title: LeetCode
description: Practice problems, company-tagged questions, weekly contests and interview study plans.

title: NeetCode
description: Free DSA roadmap (the famous NeetCode 150) with beginner-friendly video explanations.

title: GeeksforGeeks
description: Tutorials, practice problems, and interview experiences — the classic Indian engineering prep staple.

title: InterviewBit
description: Structured coding interview course with company-specific question sets and mock interviews.

title: Pramp
description: Free live mock interviews with real peers — practice technical and behavioral rounds for free.

title: IndiaBix
description: Quantitative aptitude, logical reasoning and verbal ability — the core of most placement test rounds.

title: PrepInsta
description: Aptitude, reasoning and company-specific placement test patterns with solved examples.

title: FlowCV
description: Free, ATS-friendly resume builder with clean templates and direct PDF export.

title: Novoresume
description: Modern resume builder with recruiter-approved templates and cover letter tools.

title: Overleaf Resume Templates
description: LaTeX resume and CV templates — the clean, professional format devs love (Jake's Resume is a classic).

title: GitHub Student Developer Pack
description: Free tools, credits and services for students — includes pro-tier dev tools used on real projects.

title: First Contributions
description: Practice making your very first open-source pull request — the friendliest way to learn Git.

title: Good First Issue
description: A curated list of beginner-friendly issues from real projects — find your first contribution.

title: freeCodeCamp
description: Thousands of hours of free coding lessons with industry-recognized certifications.

title: NPTEL
description: Free IIT courses with optional certified exams — great for strong fundamentals and extra credits.

title: CS50
description: Harvard's legendary introduction to computer science — completely free, self-paced.
